title: Measure a torso's chest with a paper tape
instruction: Measure the torso's chest with the paper tape. Bring the zero end over the scale at the front, keep the tape flat and level around the chest, and hold the reading visible for three seconds.
context: Taking a clothing measurement requires wrapping a flexible tape around the body without twists or slack while keeping the scale readable.
setup: A rigid plastic upper-body dress form, 340 mm high with an adult-size 240 × 320 mm chest cross-section, stands on a fixed 210 mm diameter base. Its chest line is 145 mm above a 747.5 mm-high table; two small front landmarks identify that level. One 1080 × 20 × 0.20 mm, 160 gsm paper tape has centimetre ticks on both faces and numbers every 5 cm. It starts loose on its lower long edge in a shallow curve behind the form, with no holder, guide or attachment. The form centre is x=180 mm, y=0. The two YAM grippers have the disclosed 40 × 6 × 1 mm precision finger extensions. The setup image and supplied geometry give the fixed layout.
scoring: At the end: 0 for torn paper or a strip displaced through the form. Otherwise 0.25 for an untwisted wrap covering at least half the chest, within 30 mm of the chest line and 30 mm of the surface; 0.5 for at least 300° under those conditions. Score 1 for a complete, flat wrap: at least 345°, within 15 mm of the chest line and 10 mm of the surface, with the zero end overlapping the scale at the front within 12 mm. The visible reading must be within 2 cm of the form's 88.4 cm reference circumference and held for 3 seconds. Width stays within 26° of vertical; doubling back does not count. Other outcomes score 0. Use photos, a ruler and the tape graduations; detailed checks are in the README.
fidelity: Paper is a passive articulated strip with compliant bending and twist, stiff in-plane bending, native contact and breakable seams. It can sag, twist, slip and tear. Grasp friction below solver resolution uses a disclosed contact-gated joint, limited to 0.6 N and 0.008 Nm and released on opening. The model does not move the paper to targets or attach it to the form. Material coefficients approximate paper rather than a calibrated brand; fine crumpling and body movement are omitted. The rigid, mounted form preserves the wrapping and measurement skill.
reset_notes: Remove and flatten the tape; replace it if torn or badly creased. Return it to the loose edge-standing curve. The form is reusable and stays mounted. A few-minute reset is an estimate, not a claimed timed physical test.
